errors.evidence: Description states 2022 has a maximum value of approximately 40 papers, but the figure shows it is closer to 45.
Description states that between 2002 and 2005 the total stacked amount is approximately 1 paper each year, while the figure shows higher values, indicating more papers than stated.
The description does not mention that the y-axis is labeled with '发文量/篇' (number of articles), which is crucial for understanding the data.
